explanation: A calf develops its own whistle while young and keeps it for many years. Other dolphins copy that whistle, apparently to call that particular individual.

claims.text: Bottlenose dolphins develop individual signature whistles that other dolphins use to address them.
Humpback whales, harbour seals and sea otters are not known to use signature whistles as names.
A bottlenose dolphin develops its signature whistle when young and keeps it for many years.
Dolphins copy the signature whistles of others, apparently to call those individuals.
